_readme: Assistant coverage (plan §3.4). Every table, view, granted app.* function, operator route, edge function, cron job and markdown document, with the path it reaches the owner assistant by: table_read, tool:<name>, map:<chunk kind>, index:<chunk kind>, or "excluded: <reason>". check-assistant-coverage.mjs re-derives the inventory from the code and fails on any missing or extra key. `--update` adds new keys with defaults; entries containing REVIEW must be rewritten by hand before the check passes.
